tasks.short: Read orders and hear instructions to determine work requirements.

steps.what: List the stored orders card the supervisor already filed.
Read the orders, blueprints and specifications on site.
Receive instructions from supervisors about this job.
Receive instructions from homeowners about the surfaces.
Determine the work requirements from both talks.

tasks.design: She still reads the drawings and hears the supervisor and the homeowner, then determines the work requirements herself. A separate step only lists the stored orders card in the {PROJECT} from fields the supervisor already filed. That list does not file a requirements note, does not message the homeowner, and does not raise an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: The next job often arrived as a phone call or a paper slip, so a stored card was not there to open.
tasks.enabler_now: A project card can show job id, address, surfaces, paint system and access note when the supervisor has already filed them.
tasks.still_hard: A blank card, a faded drawing, or a homeowner who changes the room on the doorstep still needs her eyes and the talk.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that the specified system will not hold on this wall, even when the card is complete.
tasks.altitude: She still reads every drawing, hears both people, and determines the requirements. She stops hunting a paper slip when the card is already filed. She does not gain a right to let the card decide the work, or to send a note to the homeowner.

reach.task: File the work order before the painter arrives
reach.learn: Which of job id, site address, surfaces, paint system and access note are already written.

evidence.claim: Hours, location and job logs per worker that observe presence and performance need works-council consent. This list shows the order's address, surfaces and paint system. It does not store her hours or a location trail.
An AI system that allocates tasks from individual behaviour or personal traits, or that evaluates worker performance, is high-risk. This list does not rank painters or assign the next job.
GPS in company vans needs a legitimate interest, and tracking private use usually fails. This task does not track the van.

Model knowledge, not a painter time study: most of this task is reading drawings and hearing instructions. Only opening a card the supervisor already filed can shrink, and only when those fields are present.

assumptions: The supervisor files, before she opens the job, job id, site address, surfaces named, specified paint system and access note. That capture sits outside this task and is not counted as saved.
If any of those fields is blank, the list step shows a blank and she reads the paper order in the read step. The list does not invent a surface or a paint system.
She does not write a requirements note in this task. Determining the requirements is her decision and is not a commit.
Hearing a supervisor or a homeowner is listening. It is not a message and not a send. The design does not email either of them, does not raise an alert, and does not track the van.
The card does not store her hours, a location trail, or a speed score. A later hours log per painter would need works-council consent and is not this list.
Upkeep of 0.2 hours per 100 hours of this task is telling the supervisor that a field on the card is wrong.
unknowns: Whether this firm already keeps work orders on a project card, or only on paper.
Whether the works council has already consented to any per-painter job log.
research_questions: Which of job id, site address, surfaces, paint system and access note does the supervisor already file before she arrives?

incremental.description: When a field on the orders card is wrong, tell the supervisor and keep using the paper order.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week of paper slips and spoken jobs, so the card is blank and she reads every order by hand. High is 1, only opening a card the supervisor already filed with job id, address, surfaces, paint system and access note. Reading the drawings, both talks, and determining the requirements stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate material amounts and estimate costs from measurements.

steps.what: Measure each surface or read measurements on the orders.
Judge coats and waste for the required materials.
Calculate amounts and costs into estimate v1.
Check estimate v1 against the surfaces, coats and prices.

tasks.design: She measures each surface and judges coats, waste and the unit price. A separate step calculates those figures into estimate v1 in the {SPREADSHEET}, and she checks that version before it stands. The filing does not send the estimate to the customer, does not place an order, and does not raise an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: Areas, coats and prices sat in her notebook, and the arithmetic was redone by hand for every room.
tasks.enabler_now: A workbook formula can multiply length, height, openings, coats, waste, coverage and unit price once she has named each figure.
tasks.still_hard: A room that is not a rectangle, or a price she does not yet have, still needs her measurement and a handwritten total.
tasks.human_edge: Judging how many coats a stained wall will actually take, which a length and a height do not show.

ambition.what: Price a small room from measured area, coats and waste, instead of guessing the litres in the van.

tasks.altitude: She still measures every surface, judges coats and waste, and checks estimate v1. She stops redoing arithmetic she has already set the figures for. She does not gain a right to let the workbook choose the coats, or to send the estimate out.

reach.task: Record surface areas on the work order when they are already known
reach.learn: Which rooms already have length, height and openings written down.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this firm: paint quantity is area, minus openings, times coats and waste, divided by coverage, then times a unit price. Only that arithmetic can be configured, and only after she has named the figures. Measuring and the coats judgement stay.
Evaluating worker performance is high-risk. This estimate records materials and cost for a job. It does not score how fast she paints.

assumptions: In the measure step she names length, height and openings for each surface, or she reads those three figures when they are already on the order. In the judge step she names coats, waste percent, coverage per litre and unit price for each required material. That capture stays at full time.
The supervisor's areas, when present, were written outside this task and are not counted as saved. If any figure is missing, the calculate step does not run and she does the arithmetic by hand.

Estimate v1 is the only filed version. She checks that version in the next step. A later edit voids the check. The step does not send the estimate to the customer, does not place an order, and does not raise an alert.
Coverage and unit price come from the tin or from a price the merchant already gave her. The design does not look up a product hub.
The estimate does not store her hours or a speed score.
Upkeep of 0.4 hours per 100 hours of this task is correcting a coverage figure, or redoing a room that is not a rectangle, by hand.
unknowns: Whether this firm already keeps a workbook for paint quantities, or only a notebook.
Whether the work order ever arrives with length, height and openings already written.
research_questions: For a typical room, which of length, height, openings, coats, waste, coverage and unit price does she already have before she starts the arithmetic?

incremental.description: When a coverage figure is wrong or the room is not a rectangle, redo that estimate by hand.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week of odd rooms and missing prices, so she calculates every job by hand. High is 4, only the arithmetic after she has named length, height, openings, coats, waste, coverage and unit price. Measuring, the coats judgement and the check of estimate v1 stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and purchase finishes for the surfaces to be covered.

steps.what: Look at surfaces for handling and application methods.
Hear customers wishes about finishes to be covered.
Select tools and finishes for durability on this job.
File purchase order v1 for the selected finishes.
Check purchase order v1 against the finishes and wishes.
Send purchase order v1 to the supplier.

tasks.design: She looks at the surface, hears the customer's wishes and selects the tools and finishes. A separate step files purchase order v1 in {PROCUREMENT}, she checks that version, and a further step sends only that version to the supplier. The send is not folded into the selection, nothing goes to the customer, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The finish was chosen on site and then ordered by a phone call, so there was no standing order to check before it left.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchasing screen can file article, quantity, unit and supplier from the selection she has already named, and send that version after she checks it.
tasks.still_hard: A colour that must be matched by eye, or a merchant who will not take an electronic order, still needs her at the counter or on the phone.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a finish that will survive this wall and still match what the customer asked to see.
tasks.altitude: She still looks at every surface, hears the customer and selects the finishes, then checks purchase order v1 before it is sent. She stops retyping and phoning an order she has already specified. She does not gain a right to let a list choose the finish, or to send an order she has not checked.

reach.task: Confirm article, quantity and lead time on a paint order
reach.learn: Which finishes the merchant will accept from an electronic order without a phone call.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this firm: choosing a finish for durability, handling and the customer's wishes is the bulk of this task. Filing and sending an order she has already specified is the small slice, and only when the merchant accepts that send.

Hours, location and job logs per worker that observe presence and performance need works-council consent. This order records article, quantity, unit and supplier. It does not store her hours or a location trail.
Evaluating worker performance, or allocating work from personal traits, is high-risk. This order does not rank her or assign the next job.

assumptions: In the select step she names article, quantity, unit and supplier for each tool or finish. That capture stays at full time. If any of those is missing, the file step and the send step do not run and she orders by phone or at the counter.

Purchase order v1 is filed first. She then checks that version against the finishes and the wishes. The send step transmits only that checked version. A change after the check voids both the file and the send.
Hearing the customer is listening. She does not send the customer a recommendation. The only send outside the organisation is purchase order v1 to the supplier.
The order does not store her hours, a location trail, or a speed score, and it does not raise an alert.
Upkeep of 0.4 hours per 100 hours of this task is a line the supplier rejects, which she then rewrites by phone.
unknowns: Whether this firm's merchant will accept an electronic order for paint and tools.
Whether a purchasing clerk, rather than the painter, places orders today.
research_questions: Which of article, quantity, unit and supplier does she already name on site before anyone phones the merchant?

incremental.description: When the supplier rejects a line, rewrite that order by phone.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week of counter buys and colour matches, so she never files an order and the send does not run. High is 3, only filing and sending purchase order v1 after she has named article, quantity, unit and supplier and has checked that version. Looking, listening and selecting stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still reads the drawings, hears the supervisor and the homeowner, measures, judges coats and finishes, and checks every filed version before it stands. She stops hunting a paper slip and retyping figures she has already named. She does not gain a right to let a card choose the work or the finish, or to send an order she has not checked.
reach: supervisor (which of job id, address, surfaces, paint system and access note are already on the order)
supplier (which finishes the merchant will accept from an electronic order)
skills_to_grow: Read a blank card as a blank, and use the paper order.
Name length, height, openings, coats, waste, coverage and unit price before the arithmetic runs.
Refuse a send of purchase order v1 until she has checked that version.
role.ambitious_version: Every job opens on a card the supervisor already filled, and every room she measures gets an estimate she has checked. She still decides the requirements, the coats and the finish. The only send outside the firm is a purchase order she has already checked.
